rationale.conceptual: The method is not a black-box library call; it requires careful choice of pseudopotentials, k-points, energy cutoffs, and handling of hybrid functional exchange mixing to accurately reproduce E2g phonon frequencies for several layer systems. The agent must correctly set up calculations for 2D materials (vacuum layers), compute phonons at Gamma, and derive the Grüneisen parameter from strain derivatives, all with sensitivity to numerical parameters that affect the final values.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves generating atomic structures, running SCF relaxations and phonon calculations for four different systems plus strain iterations, and post-processing outputs with Phonopy. This is a 5-stage workflow with dependencies, requiring integration of at least two tools (Quantum ESPRESSO and Phonopy) and careful I/O handling, but no fragile data acquisition or extremely long orchestration.
